## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Malta recorded 1,286K actual service units in 2025, +16.1% compared to 2024 (1,108K).

- Actual 2025 service units were +10.5% above the plan (1,164K).

- Actual 2025 service units are +26.1% above the actual 2019 level (1,020K).
